name: Think Smart Discounts – Dynamic Pricing, Bulk Edit & Quantity Discounts for WooCommerce
author: ThinkPlugin

sections.description:
Struggling to create compelling sales or reward loyal customers?
Think Smart Discounts is your all-in-one dynamic pricing and discount solution for WooCommerce, designed to boost your revenue with powerful, automated tools.
Whether you need a permanent bulk price editor for a quick sale, or want to set up “Buy 5, get 10% off” tiered pricing deals, our plugin provides the essential tools to build effective pricing strategies.
This plugin gives you a robust set of essential features for free and offers a seamless upgrade path to a PRO version packed with advanced marketing automation tools to take your store to the next level.

What can you do with the FREE version?

✔️ Permanent Bulk Price Editor

Need to run a store-wide sale or apply a price correction?
Our bulk pricing tool lets you permanently update the prices of hundreds or thousands of products at once.
This powerful feature is perfect for seasonal adjustments and can target all products, specific categories, or individual products.

✔️ Cart Discount (Spend & Save)

Increase your average order value by rewarding customers for spending more.
With this dynamic pricing rule, you can offer a percentage discount on their entire cart when they spend over a certain amount on all products (e.g., “Spend $100 and get a 10% cart discount!”).

✔️ Quantity Discount (Tiered Pricing)

Encourage customers to buy in bulk!
Our quantity discount feature allows you to create tiered pricing rules.
Offer a discount when a customer purchases a certain number of items.
You can apply this rule to all products, specific categories, or individual products to move inventory faster (e.g., “Buy any 5 T-Shirts and get 20% off!”).

⭐ Upgrade to Think Smart Discounts PRO to Unlock Your Store’s Full Potential ⭐

The free version is a great start, but Think Smart Discounts PRO is a complete marketing automation toolkit designed to maximize your revenue.
Boost your sales for the price of a coffee! Unlock advanced features like BOGO deals, scheduling, customer loyalty programs, and more.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the think-smart-discounts folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Smart Discount” menu in your WordPress dashboard to start creating your first dynamic pricing rule.
sections.faq:
How do I set up a quantity discount for a specific category?

In the “Smart Discount” > “Quantity Discount” menu, you can set your minimum quantity and discount percentage.
Then, under “Target Products”, select “Specific Categories” and choose the categories you want the rule to apply to.

Is the bulk pricing change reversible?

The free “Permanent Price Edit” feature is not reversible, as it directly changes the regular price of your products in the database.
For reversible sales and scheduled campaigns, you would need the PRO version.

Does this work with my theme?

Yes, Think Smart Discounts is designed to work with any theme that follows WooCommerce standards.
The discounts are applied directly to the cart calculation logic, ensuring compatibility.

Where do I find the settings?

Once activated, you will find a new menu item in your WordPress dashboard called “Smart Discount”.
All settings for bulk pricing, cart discounts, and quantity discounts are located there.

How do I get support for this dynamic pricing plugin?

For the free version, you can ask for help on the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin.
We actively monitor the forum to help our users. For faster, priority support, please consider upgrading to the PRO version.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • TWEAK: Tested up to WordPress 6.9.
  • FIX: Resolved “Plugin Check” warnings regarding global variable prefixes in view files.
  • FIX: Improved security by replacing unsafe redirects with wp_safe_redirect.
  • TWEAK: Updated main plugin function name for better standard compliance.

1.0.5

  • Fix: Resolved a critical syntax error in the Bulk Pricing module that caused a fatal error when WP_DEBUG is enabled.
  • Tweak: Improved code stability for admin pages.

1.0.4

  • Tweak: Renamed main plugin file to think-smart-discounts.php to match the official plugin slug.
  • Fix: This change resolves all “Text Domain Mismatch” warnings from the “Plugin Check” tool.

1.0.3

  • Fix: Addressed all WordPress.org review feedback including text domain, input processing, and prefixing for better security and compatibility.

1.0.2

  • Tweak: Optimized readme.txt for better SEO and clarity on WordPress.org.
  • Tweak: Updated plugin name and description to be more unique and compliant with repository guidelines.
  • Fix: Added security check to prevent direct access to admin view files.
  • Fix: Limited plugin tags to the maximum of 5 allowed by WordPress.org.

1.0.1

  • Fix: Resolved a critical bug where targeting specific categories or products in the Bulk Pricing module was not working due to a JavaScript selector error.
    This fix ensures that the “Permanent Price Edit” feature now functions correctly with all targeting options.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.

screenshots.caption: Main Dashboard: View all your active dynamic pricing campaigns and global settings in one place.
Bulk Pricing (Permanent): Easily update prices for hundreds of products at once (Free feature).
Bulk Pricing (Campaigns): Create temporary, reversible sales with scheduled start/end dates (PRO).
Quantity Discount: Set up tiered pricing rules based on total item quantity in the cart.
BOGO Deals: Create powerful "Buy X, Get Y" offers to clear inventory (PRO).
Cart Discount: Apply discounts automatically when the cart total reaches a specific threshold.
Progress Bar: Display a dynamic progress bar in the cart to encourage customers to spend more (PRO).
Loyalty Ladder: Build a tiered reward system that gives coupons as customers spend more over time (PRO).
Purchase History: Automatically reward loyal customers based on their total lifetime spending (PRO).
History Notification: Show a "Welcome Back" notification with a discount for eligible loyal customers (PRO).
Page View Discount: Convert guest visitors by offering a discount after they view a specific number of pages (PRO).
Page View Popup: The frontend popup that appears for engaged visitors to capture the sale (PRO).
Free Shipping: Set up free shipping rules based on cart total and targeted products (PRO).
Review for Discount: Incentivize social proof by giving discount credits for approved reviews (PRO).
Review Pills: Customers can easily apply their earned review credits directly in the cart (PRO).
